name: Georgy
source:
A man who works as an exorcist for the organization to which Setsuna and the others belong.
Rumored to be the most powerful member of the organization, he travels around the world exorcising demons.
He is like a mentor to Setsuna and the others, and has accompanied them on their training.
He has come to Japan this time to defeat the cult leader.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/Nightmare_x_Sisters_Omega/]official site[/url]]
